records.title: Update the Android kit with an Outlined button
records.rationale: The Android kit predates Fluent Android's Compose controls and draws only Primary and Text buttons. Compose ships OutlinedButton for Brand outline, and the contract keeps it, so Design adds an Outlined button to the kit. Until it lands, Android designers take Brand outline from the contract, not the kit.
records.revisitTrigger: The kit gains an Outlined button, or Compose drops OutlinedButton.

records.title: Add a Danger button to the iOS kit
records.rationale: Fluent iOS ships Danger for destructive actions, and the contract keeps it, so Design adds a Danger button to the iOS kit. A destructive action needs a designed look, not one improvised per product. Until it lands, iOS designers take Danger from the contract, not the kit.

records.title: Keep Transparent neutral as an iOS-only button
records.rationale: Transparent neutral is iOS's borderless bar button, a platform convention with no counterpart on web or Android. It stays an iOS-only variant, built from the iOS component rather than drawn in the shared kit.
records.revisitTrigger: Another platform adds Transparent neutral, or the iOS kit starts drawing it.

records.title: Accept iOS Cards without footer actions
records.rationale: iOS CardView is a fixed UIKit widget with no footer, and the whole card is the tap target. iOS products put actions on the screen the Card opens instead of in the Card.
records.revisitTrigger: iOS CardView gains a footer or actions slot.

records.title: Give iOS CardView a body slot
records.rationale: A Card without its body loses its point, so iOS doesn't get to drop it. Design engineering adds a body content slot to iOS CardView, and the Card reads Awaiting adoption on iOS until the slot ships.

records.title: Accept iOS Cards without a header quick action
records.rationale: iOS CardView has no accessory slot in its header, and a second tap target inside a tappable card is hard to hit on a phone. iOS products offer the quick action on the screen the Card opens.
records.revisitTrigger: iOS CardView gains a header accessory slot.

records.title: Reject Shop's local corner radius
records.rationale: Reject. The contract takes corner radius from the shape token, and a local 20 breaks it on every platform. Shop design reverts the radius, and the Card reads Awaiting adoption until the file matches.

records.title: Put Shop's promotion illustration in the Card's media slot
records.rationale: The library Card already draws hero media above its header, which is what the detached copy was made for. Shop design goes back to a library Card instance with the illustration as its hero media, so the copy stops drifting from the Card, and the Card reads Awaiting adoption until the file matches.

records.title: Harbor doesn't reach Card on Order Summary's corner-radius
records.summary: Card on Order Summary sets corner-radius to 20, which borderRadiusMedium sets. Harbor moves borderRadiusMedium from 4px to 8px, and the literal stays. Suggested: replace the literal with the token. Already decided: Reject Shop's local corner radius (awaiting-adoption); until that lands, the rebrand doesn't reach it.

records.title: Harbor doesn't reach the forked Card on Promo applied
records.summary: Card on Promo applied is a copy of the library component, so CIVIC can't tell whether it follows Harbor. It misses 3 changed tokens the library's styles read (borderRadiusLarge, borderRadiusMedium, borderRadiusSmall). Suggested: re-attach the fork to the library component. Already decided: Put Shop's promotion illustration in the Card's media slot (awaiting-adoption); until that lands, the rebrand doesn't reach it.
